verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted sync of 2FA (TOTP/HOTP) codes, but nothing shows it stores or syncs passkeys. The only passkey mention refers to passkey login for the user's Ente account itself, which is an adjacent feature. Storing passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies, and with no evidence of it the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, my passkeys sync across ecosystems — iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, browsers — instead of being locked to one platform vendor
